mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cage_shelf_grid_cache ( shelve_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY, grid_json LONGTEXT, shelf_meta_json TEXT, total_cells INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, filled_cells INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT shelve_id AS shelveId, grid_json AS gridJson, shelf_meta_json AS shelfMetaJson, total_cells AS totalCells, filled_cells AS filledCells, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cage_shelf_grid_cache WHERE shelve_id = #{shelveId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_shelf_grid_cache (shelve_id, grid_json, shelf_meta_json, total_cells, filled_cells, updated_at) VALUES (#{shelveId}, #{gridJson}, #{shelfMetaJson}, #{totalCells}, #{filledCells}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE grid_json = VALUES(grid_json), shelf_meta_json = VALUES(shelf_meta_json), total_cells = VALUES(total_cells), filled_cells = VALUES(filled_cells), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT shelve_id AS shelveId, grid_json AS gridJson FROM cage_shelf_grid_cache WHERE filled_cells > 0
